title: MD 2025 Simulation not working
content:
Hello, I've used to work with MD 2024 but after updating to 2025 today, the simulation isn't working. Pressing the usual "start simulation" button does nothing in any mode. Am I missing something?

My PC has Nvidia 4090 and AMD Ryzen 9 5950, Win 11.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Make sure the Simulation Mode is selected in GPU or CPU mode:From the top menu:Settings → User Settings → Simulation → Simulation EngineIf it is on GPU, test on the CPU, or vice versa.Sometimes new updates interfere with some graphics drivers.
Reply 1: It's all well now. I figured it out. Some AI processes interfere with the simulation.

Comment 2: Thanks for responding. After rebooting everything seems fine.

Comment 3: Can you share any images or video during the process of opening the software and simulating? That will help us understand what is going on.
content_description: This web page provides troubleshooting assistance for simulation issues encountered after updating from MD 2024 to MD 2025.

title: EVERY WE[AR] TOKYO
content:

* * *

This design showcases urban wear for an AR-driven Tokyo, where the physical and digital realms seamlessly merge. Inspired by the flow and practicality of the traditional haori, this garment blends cutting-edge technology with modern day fashion.

![0627b954fa90470fa43748176f74ce59](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/0627b954fa90470fa43748176f74ce59Main_CU_03.png)

The haori is a lightweight outer layer, intentionally plain and minimal to avoid drawing attention. It is crafted with textured recycled fabrics, subtle hexagonal patterns, and an emissive color that hints at an underlying technology.

![2e799ae450a042a8aebbe7cb16b1f30e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/2e799ae450a042a8aebbe7cb16b1f30eSuit_01_Final.png)

![120dd6098ceb4370a106fee5a852c274](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/120dd6098ceb4370a106fee5a852c274Main_CU_02.png)

title: Livesync 2.0.0 Version Tutorial
content:
Hello, I'm fadyboo who likes to use the livesync feature.  
  
Although the livesync 2 download page has the livesync2 description and instructions, I've been getting inquiries from the community and questions from around me, so I've made a video.  
  
This is a tutorial video that simply contains the parts that may cause problems and the parts that need to be checked while installing livesync2.  
  
If you are experiencing problems while using live sync, please watch it.  
I talked in Korean and attached English subtitles.
